snippet.title: CASCADE Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist CASCADE on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749900/CASCADE/

CASCADE is a stylish first-person roguelite with a focus on blazingly fast movement. Slide from surface to surface, unlock and upgrade abilities and face otherworldly enemies and bosses, all while exploring a corrupted digital space. But don't forget: Always keep on moving!

Join our mailing list and check out our other socials to stay up to date!
https://cascade-game.com

#cascadegame #godot #siliconsouls #gamedev #indiegame #glitchart
